svg.text: 3 ESP32 nodes + 1 camera: STEMMA QT sensor chain, 4 MOSFET fan/aux channels, 2 LED channels, 2 smart plugs
ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit | USB-C 5V | STEMMA QT chain: SHT31-D → SCD41 → BH1750
ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit | USB-C 5V | 4 MOSFET channels driving 12V fans + aux (relay_board_mount, outside the chamber)
CH0: FAE Fan -- Full MOSFET Circuit Detail
ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit | USB-C 5V | 2 of 4 MOSFET channels, 10-bit PWM dimming, no diodes
Same MOSFET circuit as the relay node (100R gate, 10K pull-down) but NO flyback diode: LED strips are resistive.
Tri-spectrum: BLUE wire → CH1, common wire → +12V; insulate the red + green wires. Shares the 12V PSU.
ESP32-CAM | OV2640 or OV3660 | on its CAM-MB
No GPIO wiring. A still every 15 min over WiFi.
DC pigtail → +12V / GND buses. Keep ≤ ~4 A: cut strips to length
Tasmota MQTT: User sp-3p, Password SPOREPRINT_MQTT_3P_PASSWORD
Climate Node (STEMMA QT chain, no soldering):
12. Source --> GND bus (shared w/ PSU + ESP32 GND)
13. UF4007 across Fan(+) / Fan(-), band to +12V
Same MOSFET circuit, LED strip instead of fan, NO diode.
CH0: White (GPIO 25). CH1: tri-spectrum BLUE wire (GPIO 26).
No GPIO wiring -- 5V + flashing via its ESP32-CAM-MB (micro-USB).
Each ESP32: own 5V USB charger + USB-C cable. Plugs: WiFi only,
user sp-3p + Full Topic tasmota/%topic%/%prefix%/ (see the build guide).
